subject: Handoff: Borealis Health - operational brief & kickoff request
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Liu <dana.liu@borealishealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Borealis Health - operational brief & kickoff request

Hi team,

Quick handoff note following signature this morning (SOW & order form attached). High-level context and ask below so CS can pick up the runbook and schedule kickoff.

Deal summary / scope:
- Account: Borealis Health (Series B telehealth provider)
- Committed: Dedicated pool (4x A100 equiv nodes), reserved for 12 months; expected steady-state ~10k inference requests/day, peak bursts up to 80 qps.
- Features purchased: chat generation, embeddings (batch-only), per-route tracing + token-level cost analytics.
- Compliance: customer requires HIPAA handling, SOC 2 evidence requested (we delivered certs).

Key dates:
- Contract signed: 2027-05-10
- Target kickoff window: within 5 business days (prefer Wed/Thu next week)
- Production target: ramp to prod traffic by 2027-06-15

Primary external contacts:
- Dana Liu (technical lead, dana.liu@borealishealth.ai)
- Procurement: procurement@borealishealth.ai
- Security contact: secops@borealishealth.ai

Internal notes / risks to surface to CS:
- They will want SSO (SAML) + customer-managed KMS for key rotation. We have KMS onboarding steps but will need Security to share template scoping items.
- Expect request for model quantization profile (they favor int8/peft for latency). Research recommended a custom quantization pass but that may require 1-2 weeks of tuning.
- Data residency: US-only region required — routing policy should pin traffic to us-east-1.

Attachments included: Borealis_SOW_signed.pdf, order-form-6789.pdf (both signed).

Ask: Please assign a CS owner and propose two 60-min kickoff slots. I can join the first 30 minutes for introductions. Neha — if you take point, please confirm and I'll share contract copies & HubSpot deal link.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachment: order-form-6789.pdf (pdf, 56 KB)

Assigning CS owner: Neha Kapoor will lead onboarding and be the day-to-day point of contact. Neha@redwood, can you confirm ownership?

1) Contract & SOW copies (Markus pls confirm full docs are attached; I will pull from HubSpot if needed) [P1]
2) Proposed kickoff slots (2 options within next 5 business days) [P1]
3) Technical contacts and SSO requirements (SAML metadata, IdP contact) [P1]

Operational note: I saw mention of custom quantization. Please include Research/Applied ML in the intro so they can assess model performance/regression risk.

Markus: if HubSpot has a doc link or procurement contact info, paste it in thread.

Thanks,

Hi all — happy to own this onboarding.

Quick plan / next steps from CS (high level):
- Owner: Neha Kapoor (CS Lead) — neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
- Kickoff: propose Tue 2027-05-11 10:00 PT (per Dana's availability). I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in.
- Pre-kickoff requests (please action before the call):
  * Markus: confirm HubSpot link & share the signed SOW in Drive (I will reconcile attachments)
  * Dana: please share Okta SAML metadata and the list of initial test accounts (3 dev/test users)
  * Security: please send SOC2 cover letter and pen test summary to secops@borealishealth.ai (cc me) — we'll archive in the customer evidence locker.
- 2-week onboarding milestone plan (to be refined in kickoff):
  1) Week 1: Environment setup (VPC peering, routing policy to us-east-1, KMS config, SSO)
  2) Week 2: Model validation & performance tuning (quantization profile assessment, small batch test, latency SLO checks), and integration of tracing hooks
  3) Post-week-2: Gradual ramp to prod and scheduled runbook handoff to account team

Attachments: kickoff-agenda.pdf (draft) — included in the invite.

Risks / blockers to escalate now:
- Any delay on SAML metadata or KMS admin access will push the environment setup by 3-4 business days.
- If the quantization pass is required for latency, we will need Research to allocate time (I will open a support ticket and tag SUP-4512).

I'll post the calendar invite and a shared Drive folder with checklists and the activation playbook. Markus — I'll loop you into the Drive and HubSpot doc.

Thanks,

Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
